story_text: As a user, I want to see an error when I try to log in with a wrong password so that I know my credentials are incorrect.

positive.title: Allow login after correcting previously incorrect password
steps: 2. Enter a valid email address in the email field.
3. Enter an incorrect password in the password field.
5. After receiving the error message, enter the correct password in the password field.
positive.expected_result: User receives an error message for the incorrect password and is able to log in successfully after entering the correct password.

positive.title: Display error message for incorrect password
steps: 2. Enter a valid email address in the email field.
3. Enter an incorrect password in the password field.
positive.expected_result: User receives an error message indicating that the password is incorrect.

positive.title: Allow password reset after multiple failed login attempts
steps: 2. Enter a valid email address in the email field.
3. Enter an incorrect password in the password field.
positive.expected_result: User is prompted to reset their password after multiple failed login attempts.

negative.title: Display generic error message for incorrect password
steps: 2. Enter a valid email address in the email field.
3. Enter an incorrect password in the password field.
negative.expected_result: User receives a generic error message.

negative.title: Allow login with incorrect password
steps: 2. Enter a valid email address in the email field.
3. Enter an incorrect password in the password field.
negative.expected_result: User is allowed to log in with an incorrect password.

negative.title: Error message displayed for correct password
steps: 2. Enter a valid email address in the email field.
3. Enter the correct password in the password field.
negative.expected_result: User receives an error message indicating that the password is incorrect.

edge.title: Login with password different only in case sensitivity
steps: 2. Enter a valid email address in the email field.
3. Enter a password that differs only in case sensitivity from the correct password in the password field.
edge.expected_result: User is prevented from logging in with a password that differs only in case.

edge.title: Login with password that has leading or trailing spaces
steps: 2. Enter a valid email address in the email field.
3. Enter a password that has leading or trailing spaces in the password field.
edge.expected_result: User is prevented from logging in with a password that has leading or trailing spaces.

edge.title: Login with password that contains special characters
steps: 2. Enter a valid email address in the email field.
3. Enter a password that contains special characters in the password field.
edge.expected_result: User is prevented from logging in with a password that contains special characters if the original password does not contain them.
